## Environment
- **Lekt Version:** (e.g. `1.2.2`)
- **Operating System:** (e.g. macOS 15 Apple Silicon / Windows 11 x64)
- **Installer Type:** (DMG / EXE / MSI / Microsoft Store)

## Describe the Issue
A clear description of what happened and what you expected.

## PDF/UA Rule or Reproduction Steps
1. Open PDF (please do **not** attach confidential student/medical/legal PDFs; anonymized or minimal repro PDFs are best)
2. Run validation profile (`PDF/UA-1`, `PDF/UA-2`, or `WCAG 2.2`)
3. Exact clause/rule or UI behavior observed
